q: Can the same person be my realtor and my loan officer in California?
a: Yes, if they hold both a California DRE real estate license and an NMLS mortgage loan originator license and provide the required dual-capacity disclosures. Steven Shearrill holds both: DRE #01988316 and NMLS #2449246.

q: Can I buy a house with BAH?
a: Yes. Lenders count Basic Allowance for Housing as qualifying income for a VA loan, and because BAH is tax-free it is often grossed up in the debt-to-income calculation, which can increase your purchase power.

q: Do I need a down payment for a VA loan in Temecula or San Diego?
a: No down payment is required by the VA for eligible veterans, service members and some surviving spouses, and VA loans carry no monthly mortgage insurance. A down payment is optional and reduces the VA funding fee. Lender credit and property requirements apply.

q: Can I use my VA loan more than once?
a: Yes. VA entitlement can be restored after you sell and pay off a VA loan, and with remaining entitlement you can hold two VA loans at once, which lets many service members buy at a new duty station while keeping the previous home as a rental.
